hero.title: Distributed Market Intelligence
hero.subtitle: Self-Validating Quant Platform
hero.tagline: A self-validating quant pipeline with live job tracking and a Next.js control plane.
hero.impact: Most projects stop at results — this one validates them in real time, streams every stage over WebSocket, and ships signals, backtest, and versioned runs in one local research workstation.

problem.label: 01 — The Problem
problem.title: Four gaps most financial projects ignore.
problem.intro: Most projects stop at "I got results." These four gaps matter in production.

howItWorks.label: 02 — How It Works
howItWorks.title: Four layers, seven pipeline stages.
howItWorks.pipelineNote: Then SAVING_DATA → COMPLETED; UI fetches via /features, /qa, and /api/v1/*.

problems.d: Pandas breaks at scale — PySpark handles multi-ticker workloads.
Rolling metrics and drawdown need careful window functions per ticker.
Formal QA scores Spark output against a Pandas/SciPy benchmark.
WebSocket streams every pipeline stage — no black-box runs.

archLayers.title: UI Layer
archLayers.desc: Next.js dashboard — run pipeline, jobs, QA, signals, backtest, reports

archLayers.title: Processing Layer
archLayers.desc: PySpark — ingest, validate, features, QA, signals, backtest, versioned export

archLayers.title: Job & Persistence
archLayers.desc: BackgroundTasks + job_id + DuckDB history; single active-run lock (409)

flowStepsDetail: Next.js UI — ticker input (dates in config.json)
Seven stages above, then SAVING_DATA → COMPLETED
DuckDB stores QA, signals, backtest per run_id
Single pipeline lock — 409 if a run is already active
Snapshot mode: per-ticker CSV under data/snap/; live mode: yfinance

highlights.name: QA Validation System

highlights.name: Real-time Execution
highlights.desc: WebSocket timeline for all stages; job_id routing; 409 lock on concurrent runs.

highlights.name: Next.js Control Plane
highlights.desc: Dashboard, Run pipeline, Jobs, Explorer, QA, Signals, Regime, Backtest, Reports, Settings.

highlights.name: Local Research Platform
highlights.desc: backend/ + web/ + config.json; snapshot or live ingestion; Docker Compose & start_dev.sh.

futureWork: Phases 1–4 are complete (PySpark pipeline, FastAPI, Next.js UI, WebSocket + job_id). Phase 5 adds a Vercel-friendly static demo mode. Phase 6 covers MLlib/Torch models, Recharts, auth, and pytest — ML features are roadmap only; today the platform ships engineered features, rule-based signals, backtest, and formal QA.
